title: BillingTransactionReversedPayload
description: billing.transaction.reversed v1 (OpenVibe.Billing server/ops/reversals.js reverseReceipt, transfers.js refund, cashouts.js deny). A transaction reversing an earlier one was posted: a provider refund or chargeback, a donation refund, a denied cash-out. Envelope: subject { type: transaction, id: txn_… (the reversing transaction) }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:billing.

from_subject.description: Subject id (usr_…) value moved from, null for provider money.

provider.description: stripe, paypal, powerchat…; null for credit movements.

metadata.description: Transaction metadata as posted (amount_bits, paid_cents, value_cents, target EntityRef, intent_id, message, donor_name, rates…). Its keys depend on the transaction type.

review.description: Provider reversals only: required when Billing kept value it could not recover (staff review).

entitlements_revoked.description: Provider reversals only: subscription periods revoked.
